title: Patricia Is The Ultimate Guide For Private Tour in Barcelona
text: Patricia was a great guide. She did a great job of imparting the history of not only the Segrada and the Gaudi Houses but telling us about all the neighborhoods of Barcelona. She was extremely accommodating and very friendly. She also sent me some nice suggestions for a good wine store and showed us where the Boqueria Market was. This was my favorite part besides seeing the Segrada Familia.
author: Julie_B
